professionalSummary.text: Maintains CI build infrastructure and remote caching for a monorepo of approximately four million lines of code at Vantor Labs since January 2020.

professionalSummary.text: Built a Go command-line tool enabling engineers to reproduce CI failures locally with identical container images and environment variables as the pipeline.
professionalSummary.witness: Built a Go command-line tool that lets engineers reproduce CI failures locally with the same container image and environment variables as the pipeline.

professionalSummary.text: Quarantined intermittent failing tests, filed tickets to owning teams, and restored tests after fixes were validated by teams.
